target.name: Braxusx/FarCry2VR contribution baseline; updated source identified by artifact hashes

question: Can the source mix the previous weapon model with the next weapon, and which bounded offline checks prevent reuse across an observed cohort change or unknown image?
claim: Baseline source queries the previous weapon's model before observing the current weapon, inside HandGrab's gate. The local changes observe in producer order, independently of interactions, and fence selected pose products with an expiring observed cohort. Native integration now refuses unmeasured or nonmatching images rather than defaulting to Steam. These are source mechanisms and offline regression results, not native lifetime or headset acceptance.
method: Inspected git show 8f0d63b501c3320098159273572f3ca82f90d42d:mod/src/arms.cpp HandInteract and current producer/consumer adapters. CMake 48-group MSVC Win32 Release suite (83,935 assertions and five wiring guards), GCC 16.2.0 x86 / -Wall -Wextra -Werror for the eight new groups, five isolated rebuilt mutants, and a complete x86 DLL build with no new warnings. Production InspectFile read the installed Steam Dunia file without loading it and matched PowerShell SHA-256. Commands, exact image/build hash and limits are in the checkpoint. Initialized the fleet receipt template under ignored build, then used donor identity for standalone validation; no fleet submission because this checkout is unregistered and the user requested local-only work.

identity.reason: Full baseline commit and current production/test artifact hashes identify the inspected donor source; exact enabled Steam image and output DLL hashes are recorded in the checkpoint.

instrument.reason: Compiler/test success, 48 nonempty groups, production file-measurement positive control and assertion-failing mutants were inspected. Validators and compilation were not game execution.

control.reason: Continuous same-owner and complete-palette controls pass; removed epoch/heartbeat/coverage/digest/refusal protections each cause the intended assertion failures.

scene.reason: Source/offline task only; no game scene, process attachment or headset use authorized or required.

restore.reason: Persistent contribution-branch source changes; broken variants remained isolated in ignored build and were never injected, deployed or linked into the production DLL.

baseline.reason: The changed source passes all 48 offline groups and the complete x86 DLL build. This is an offline regression baseline only; runtime and headset baseline health were not measured.

limits: Observed metadata is not a native object reference, worker lease or allocator ABA proof. Existing native calls/offsets were reordered, not newly ABI-proved. No GOG exact image/table binding, native reload ticket/weapon acknowledgement, definitive saved-hold asset identity, NPC target/driver or monocular visibility lifetime proof, or runtime acceptance. Full-file identity does not establish in-memory integrity. ArmRigFix remains default-off; no manual reload, physical steering or DQS was added.

do_not_repeat.approach: Treat timestamp/size or a weapon pointer alone as a native access/pose lease
do_not_repeat.reason: Same-header image variants and same-pointer model/palette or A-B-A changes defeat those shortcuts in the inspected code and controls.
do_not_repeat.reopen_when: An exact image-to-profile binding or target-proved lifetime/generation mechanism supersedes the observed-cohort gate.
